about: The site's delivery in a real browser (tools/ci/site-browser.sh, tools/ci/site-perf.mjs): the built page served as Pages serves it (gzip), a cold visit over a 20 Mbit/s, 40 ms connection at 1280×800, then to the features and back. Bytes, milliseconds.

budgets.why: 4.4 MB (2026-11-02): the wasm 2.4 compressed, the fonts 2.0; nothing fetched after the first frame. C2's goal is under 5 MB (the master plan, W8)

4.4 MB on the way to the first frame (2026-11-02): the program and the fonts — Noto Sans SC cut to the site's characters and the 3755 common ones; the next step (performance tiers §7: the first frame drawn ahead, the program split) is less before the first frame
2.1 s locally (3.1 s before the site's places were pages, 2026-11-02): the transfer at 20 Mbit/s is most of it; a slower runner's headroom
